name: GOAT
uses: Steer coding agents across your own machines: each host runs a GOAT server that owns projects, threads, provider sign-ins and memory, and a client can start or move a thread, including Grok Build and OpenCode providers.
features: per-machine server for projects, threads and memory
start or move a thread, including uncommitted changes
Grok Build and OpenCode providers listed
Fleet view of what is running and what needs you
